verdict.rationale: Computer's own docs say it can search and browse the web for real-time information, which covers grounding answers in current web results. Nothing in the pack documents that its answers include citations or links back to sources, so only half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented source citations in answers, evidence of how answers are grounded and attributed, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can get answers grounded in current web results with citations back to the sources

citations.quote: Search and browse the web for real-time information, including login-gated pages
